spatial_gaps: Kirkuk: five named records still lie within the single citadel precinct; a market improves category variety but does not resolve geographic concentration.
Baghdad: six monuments share the Rusafa riverbank tentative ensemble; additional districts and periods remain underrepresented.
Salah al-Din: four records belong to Samarra and one to Ashur. Tikrit, Balad and prehistoric locations remain research priorities.

media_gaps.note: Missing images remain honest fallbacks; no uncertain media is inserted to make coverage look complete.

interpretation: Numerical governorate/theme balance passes for this source-backed Phase 6 export. Spatial breadth and image coverage remain incomplete and are explicitly queued; the dataset is not an exhaustive inventory. Balance applies to the prepared/exported dataset, not to unchanged live frontend data.
